carpet.rule.fishingTreasureNoOpenWater.n: Fishing with no open water requirement
carpet.rule.fishingTreasureNoOpenWater.d: Restores pre-1.16 fishing: treasure can be caught without a 5x4x5 open water area.
carpet.rule.fishingTreasureNoOpenWater.e: true - ignore the open water requirement, normal treasure chance
imba - only treasure loot, no fish and no junk
carpet.rule.hoebedrockbreaking.name: Hoe can break bedrock
carpet.rule.hoebedrockbreaking.desc: A hoe can break bedrock. No drops (Silk Touch included), 1 durability per block (Unbreaking applies); breaking time equals a pickaxe mining stone.
carpet.rule.botnoclip.name: Bots cannot be pushed
carpet.rule.botnoclip.desc: No entity can push Carpet fake players (bots) around, so a placed bot stays put. Note: bots can still push players; the two cannot fully overlap.
carpet.rule.botnoclip.extra.0: false - vanilla (bots and players push each other)
carpet.rule.botnoclip.extra.1: true - nothing can push bots (bots can still push players)
carpet.rule.botToolSwap.name: Bots auto-equip better tools
carpet.rule.botToolSwap.desc: When a Carpet fake player picks up a tool, it switches it into the main hand if it is better: only the same kind of tool is compared; Mending wins first; otherwise the higher total enchantment level wins, with each curse level counted as -10. It also replaces a held tool whose remaining durability is down to 10% (at least 1 point) with the same tool that has the most durability in its inventory.
carpet.rule.botToolSwap.extra.0: false - vanilla (bots keep whatever is in the main hand)
carpet.rule.botToolSwap.extra.1: true - bots auto-switch to a better picked-up tool and replace nearly broken tools
carpet.rule.noBatSpawning.name: No bat spawning
carpet.rule.noBatSpawning.desc: Disables natural bat spawning by setting the ambient spawn rate to 0 (the same table /spawn rates writes to). Spawn eggs, spawners and commands still work; mobs already in the world are unaffected. For phantoms use the vanilla /gamerule spawn_phantoms false.
carpet.rule.noBatSpawning.extra.0: false - vanilla (bats spawn in dark places)
carpet.rule.botmemo.name: Bot memo (save/restore bot state)
carpet.rule.botmemo.desc: Allows /botmemo <name> save to remember a bot's position, rotation and current actions, and /botmemo <name> run to restore them; if the bot is offline it is spawned at the saved position.
carpet.rule.botmemo.extra.1: true - /botmemo can save and restore bot state
carpet.rule.botChineseName.name: Unicode bot names
carpet.rule.botChineseName.desc: Allows Carpet's /player command to accept quoted Unicode names such as "测试". When off, Unicode /player commands are rejected; toggling takes effect immediately.
carpet.rule.deathchest.name: Death chest
carpet.rule.deathchest.desc: When a player dies, their items are stored in one or two chests (27 stacks each) at the death spot instead of being scattered. No protection, no owner label, no experience storage.
carpet.rule.deathchest.extra.0: false - vanilla (items drop on the ground)
carpet.rule.deathchest.extra.1: true - items go into chests at the death spot
carpet.rule.leashableVillagers.name: Leashable villagers
carpet.rule.leashableVillagers.desc: A lead can be attached to villagers and wandering traders, and they can be pulled around like other leashable mobs.
carpet.rule.leashableVillagers.extra.1: true - villagers and wandering traders can be leashed and pulled
carpet.rule.villagerneverstoptrading.des: Villagers and wandering traders never run out of trades: the used count is frozen, so a trade never locks and demand never grows. Cheap, O(1) per trade, no commands or NBT rewriting.
carpet.rule.villagerneverstoptrading.ext: false - vanilla (trades lock after max uses, prices rise with demand)
true - infinite trades; uses frozen, demand never grows, prices stay at their current value
carpet.rule.noAquaticSpawning.name: No aquatic mob spawning
carpet.rule.noAquaticSpawning.desc: Disables natural spawning for water creatures (fish, dolphins), water ambient (squid), underground water creatures and axolotls by setting their Carpet spawn rate to 0. Existing mobs, spawn eggs, spawners and commands are unaffected.
carpet.rule.crispydeepslate.name: Crispy deepslate
carpet.rule.crispydeepslate.desc: Mines the deepslate block as if its hardness were stone's 1.5 instead of 3.0. Deepslate ores keep their own hardness, and the block itself drops the same item as before.
carpet.rule.crispydeepslate.extra.1: true - deepslate is mined at stone speed (hardness 1.5)
carpet.rule.TNTdrag.name: TNT air drag precision
carpet.rule.TNTdrag.desc: Controls the air drag factor applied to primed TNT each tick. float keeps vanilla 26.2+ behaviour (a float 0.98F widened to double); doublefloat restores the pre-26.2 double literal 0.98D.
